package.description: The single point of access to ABB LP Design Software.

en-US.description: The single point of access to ABB LP Design Software.
en-US.longDescription:
ABB presents e-Design, the new engineering software suite launched as a tool to meet the needs of electrical sector professionals working in a constantly changing market.
e-Design makes it possible to design an electrical system, optimizing production times to the maximum, thanks to the ability to access a product portfolio to be used in synergy through intuitive and simple functionalities.
The suite’s appealing and brand-new look, combined with a general optimization of the functionalities that have always characterised ABB software, make it an innovative tool in step with the technologies currently available in the sector.
en-US.name: e-Design

zh-CN.description: ABB LP 设计软件聚合。
zh-CN.longDescription:
ABB 推出了一款全新的工程设计软件套件 e-Design，旨在满足电气行业专业人士在不断变化的市场中的需求。
e-Design 让电气系统的设计成为可能，通过直观、简单的功能来访问可以协同使用的产品套件，最大限度地优化了生产时间。
该套件外观新颖，极具吸引力，同时对 ABB 软件一贯的功能进行了全面优化，使其成为与当前行业技术同步的创新工具。
